trace.question: List all the members of the "School of Applied Sciences, Technology and Education" department.
trace.evidence: list all members means to list all the full name; full name refers to first_name, last_name;

attempts.sql:
SELECT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name
FROM member m
JOIN major j ON m.link_to_major = j.major_id
WHERE j.college = 'School of Applied Sciences, Technology and Education'

SELECT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name
FROM member m
JOIN major j ON m.link_to_major = j.major_id
WHERE j.department LIKE '%School of Applied Sciences, Technology and Education%'
   OR j.college LIKE '%School of Applied Sciences, Technology and Education%'

verdicts.text:
